import numpy as np
from scipy import ndimage

def transform(g):
    a=np.array(g); H,W=a.shape
    # find palette bar
    bar=None
    for r in range(H):
        row=a[r]; nz=np.nonzero(row)[0]
        if len(nz)>=3 and np.all(np.diff(nz)==1) and len(set(row[nz]))>=3:
            bar=(r,nz[0],list(row[nz])); break
    r0,c0,pal=bar
    h=1
    while r0+h<H and list(a[r0+h,c0:c0+len(pal)])==pal: h+=1
    barrows=list(range(r0,r0+h)); barcols=list(range(c0,c0+len(pal)))
    mask=(a!=0); mask[np.ix_(barrows,barcols)]=False
    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)

    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ys,xs=np.nonzero(lab==i)
        r1,r2,c1,c2=ys.min(),ys.max(),xs.min(),xs.max()
        sub=a[r1:r2+1,c1:c2+1]
        oc=int(np.unique(sub[sub!=0])[0])
        objs.append((r1,r2,c1,c2,sub,oc))
    objs.sort()
    r1=objs[0][0]; k0=pal.index(objs[0][5])

    for j in range(k0):
        rr=r1-(k0-j)*(objs[0][1]-objs[0][0]+1)

            o=sub.copy(); o[sub!=0]=pal[j]
